facts.fact: StackAdapt reports that 80% of marketers prioritize performance marketing over brand building.
facts.quote: Today, [80% of marketers](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/downloads/state-programmatic-advertising-report) prioritize it over brand building

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's research, nearly nine in 10 marketers say gaps in measurement reduce their trust in channel performance.
facts.quote: nearly nine in 10 marketers say gaps in measurement reduce their trust in channel performance

facts.fact: StackAdapt's research says top-performing teams are three times more likely to focus heavily on performance marketing.
facts.quote: top-performing teams are three times more likely to focus heavily on performance marketing.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that high-performing marketers plan brand and performance together, aligning teams around shared outcomes rather than separate KPIs.
facts.quote: They plan brand and performance together, aligning teams around shared outcomes rather than separate KPIs.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that marketers who perform well maintain investment in awareness and consideration even under pressure, because they see how it improves efficiency lower in the funnel.
facts.quote: Even under pressure, they maintain investment in awareness and consideration because they can see how it improves efficiency lower down.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article states that strong measurement looks for evidence of incrementality and downstream impact instead of relying solely on channel-level attribution.
facts.quote: Instead of relying solely on channel-level attribution, they look for evidence of incrementality and downstream impact.

facts.fact: StackAdapt's article says advertising across the funnel in 2026 rewards marketers who connect brand and performance advertising.
facts.quote: Advertising across the funnel in 2026 rewards marketers who connect these dots.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes its platform as built to support a full-funnel strategy, letting teams run brand and performance campaigns together and measure impact across the journey (vendor claim, no figures given).
facts.quote: is built to support a full-funnel strategy, enabling teams to activate brand and performance campaigns together and measure their impact across the journey.
